description: This file defines an abstract base class for random number generators that generate streams of bits, providing core random generation methods and common functionality for subclasses.

classes.name: BitsStreamGenerator
classes.description: Abstract class for generating streams of random bits, implementing core methods for various primitive random values, including support for Gaussian distribution generation.

methods.name: BitsStreamGenerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the internal Gaussian cache variable.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Abstract methods to set seed using different input types (int, int array, long).

methods.name: next
methods.description: Abstract core method to generate a specified number of random bits.

methods.name: nextBytes
methods.description: Fills a byte array with random bytes.

methods.name: nextDouble
methods.description: Returns a uniformly random double between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: nextFloat
methods.description: Returns a uniformly random float between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Returns a Gaussian-distributed random number using the Box-Muller transform with caching.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Returns a uniformly random integer in [0, n), with rejection sampling for non-power-of-two n.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Returns a uniformly random 64-bit long value.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Returns a random long in [0, n), with rejection sampling.
